name: Duskframe Fixer's Underworld Complete Set
description:
The fixer's uniform: a structured midi-length coat in deep plum-black synthetic wool, unbranded, with internal pocket architecture — flat-sewn channels for datasticks, a concealed mag-clasp holster at the left hip, chrome-arm relief seams. Beneath: a high-neck compression top in charcoal viscose-analog, and tailored straight-leg trousers with a subtle ikat-weave pattern suggesting West African and Central Asian textile fusion. Ankle boots are pull-on, rubber-soled, heel-compressed for silence.

The ensemble reads as Tier-3 from a distance — respectable, forgettable. On close inspection the coat's inner lining is hand-stitched signal-dampening mesh, and the collar has a BCI-dead-zone strip sewn into the band.
functionality: Signal-dampening coat lining disrupts passive BCI scanning, concealed internal datastick channels, mag-clasp hip holster, chrome-arm relief seams, BCI-dead-zone collar strip, heel-compressed silent soles.
what_it_says: Whoever this is, they have been in every room they weren't supposed to be in — and left nothing behind.
story_hooks: The signal-dampening lining is a newer weave than the coat — someone upgraded this after purchase, and that someone had access to restricted materials.
The ikat-weave trousers are hand-loomed, traceable to a single artisan collective in the Circuit — a calling card for those who know.
A CorpSec scanner flags the BCI-dead-zone collar strip as contraband, but the officer hesitates — this person has a look that says the arrest would cost more than the charge.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately understated silhouette designed for urban navigation and discretion. The structured midi coat dominates the composition—architectural, purposeful, worn by someone who moves through shadows. Layered beneath is a sleek compression top and tailored trousers. The overall effect is controlled, functional, neither flashy nor ragged. This is what competence looks like.
physical_description.fit: Precise and fitted without being form-hugging. The coat sits structured at the shoulders with a slight taper at the torso, then releases into a controlled A-line midi cut that hits mid-calf. Compression top follows the body closely for freedom of movement. Trousers are tailored straight-leg with a subtle rise, designed for both sitting and rapid motion. Ankle boots are close-fitting, engineered for silence.
physical_description.primary_material: Deep plum-black synthetic wool (coat exterior), charcoal viscose-analog (compression top), blended synthetic with ikat-patterned weave (trousers), reinforced rubber sole (boots). Internal signal-dampening mesh lining (coat) adds weight and proprietary function.
physical_description.texture: Coat exterior is smooth and dense, almost matte—light absorption rather than reflection. Compression top is fitted and slightly ribbed. Trousers feature a subtle woven texture from the ikat pattern, breaking visual monotony. Boots have a faint scuff-resistant finish on the rubber. Internal mesh creates a whisper-thin tactile layer.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep plum-black as primary (coat, boots). Charcoal compression top. Trousers in dark base with ikat pattern in rust, indigo, and cream tones—a deliberate nod to non-corp textile heritage. Chrome-arm relief seams catch minimal light at the coat's sleeve transitions.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snaps down the front of the coat (silent, no jingle, no catches). The mag-clasp holster at left hip operates on friction-fit + subtle locking pressure. Compression top has no closure. Trousers fasten with a reinforced mag-latch at the waist. Boots are pull-on with internal compression fit.
distinctive_features: Internal flat-sewn pocket channels designed specifically for datasticks and flat tech
Concealed mag-clasp holster at left hip (sized for compact pistol or baton)
Chrome-arm relief seams at sleeve transitions—functional AND aesthetic
Hand-stitched signal-dampening mesh lining throughout coat
BCI-dead-zone strip sewn into collar band (blocks neural interface broadcast within ~0.5m radius)
Ikat-weave pattern on trousers (West African + Central Asian textile fusion—intentional cultural synthesis)
Heel-compressed rubber soles engineered for silent movement
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 at first glance (respectable, functional, corpo-adjacent). Tier 3-4 on detailed inspection due to hand-stitching and signal-tech integration. The unlicensed manufacture and street-label origin signal a person operating outside corporate supply chains—strategic middle ground between corporate legitimacy and sub-grade visibility.
physical_description.cultural_context: This is fixer armor. The wearer operates in legal gray zones—information brokers, private investigators, street-level networkers, people who need to move through both corporate and underground spaces without announcing themselves. The textile fusion (ikat) signals cosmopolitan awareness and deliberate cultural eclecticism. Wearing this says: 'I know how to move unnoticed. I have secrets. I am competent and calm.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Purchased broken-in or lightly worn. Fixers replace these before visible damage accumulates. The fabric resists creasing and shows wear slowly. Over time, minor scuffs appear on the boots, and the interior mesh develops a faint shine from contact. Never allowed to become shabby—degradation signals unreliability.

image_prompt: A figure in deep plum-black synthetic wool coat with structured midi silhouette stands in profile against a dimly lit GLMZ alleyway, rain-slicked concrete and neon signs bleeding soft blue-pink light in the background. The coat's internal signal-dampening mesh is just visible at the open collar, revealing a charcoal compression top beneath. Tailored straight-leg trousers with subtle rust and indigo ikat pattern visible at the thigh. Pull-on ankle boots with matte rubber soles catch minimal light. The pose is casual but alert—one hand near the concealed mag-clasp holster at the left hip. Moody, high-contrast lighting. Cyberpunk fixer aesthetic. Dark urban backdrop.
